The left pane: the test forest rendered through the clicky `Tree`. Selection, handlers and adapters all come from the runner context; failing branches and the top level open by default.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/test-runner/TestTree.tsx)

```tsx
import { TestTree } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
